{{Top|leg}}
The '''Karideph operations''' were a series of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karideph]],<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> sometime prior [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="AIR-Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Alliance soldiers [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Akul Witig]] and [[Ma'w'shiye]] took part in the operations. Witig gave a heavy overcoat to Ma'w'shiye during the campaign.<ref name="WBC">{{JournalCite|4|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
